verdict.rationale: Evidence shows three.js is a code-first WebGL/WebGPU library installed via npm/git and used with standard `WebGLRenderer` setup, but nothing documents a CLI or automated pipeline for building/exporting a 'project' headlessly in CI (no headless rendering support, no export tooling, no CI recipes) — the only editor mentioned (threejs.org/editor) is a browser GUI requiring human interaction. missing for 10: any documented headless rendering approach (e.g. headless-gl/Node canvas), a CLI build/export command, and CI pipeline examples.
